skills.name: Like-Denominator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions, or the fractional parts of mixed numbers, once they already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Convert fractions with different denominators into equivalent fractions sharing a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one whole unit and rewrite it as a fraction when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Normalization
skills.definition: Simplify a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.
